exams.name: Written and practical examination (board-administered)
exams.notes: Administered by the Arkansas Board of Dispensing Opticians at least once per year; covers mechanical optics, occupational vision requirements, facial measurements, ophthalmic lens types, fitting and adjusting glasses.
exams.quote: No person ... shall provide ophthalmic dispensing services to the public until after he or she has passed the written and practical examination conducted by the board

interval_years.quote: the person shall have his or her certificate of licensure or registry renewed for an additional year commencing on July 1 of that year

required.quote: The board may require proof of successful completion of its continuing education requirements as a condition for renewal of license

hours_per_period.quote: the board shall not require more than nine (9) clock hours of continuing education within any two-year period

period_years.quote: the board shall not require more than nine (9) clock hours of continuing education within any two-year period

available.quote: Any person who desires to provide ophthalmic dispensing services to the public as a licensed or registered dispensing optician in this state and who holds a current validated certificate of licensure or registry as a dispensing optician in a state whose requirements for licensure or registry are in the opinion of the Arkansas Board of Dispensing Opticians at least equivalent to those of this state may at the discretion of the board be issued a certificate of licensure or a certificate of registry.

requirements.value: Must hold current validated certificate in a state with equivalent requirements; must have provided dispensing services for at least 5 years (licensure) or 3 years (registration) in the state of licensure; that state must grant like reciprocal privileges to Arkansas-licensed opticians; no written or practical examination required; fee must be paid.
requirements.quote: The certificate may be issued without a written or practical examination upon payment of the fee ... Has provided ophthalmic dispensing services to the public as a dispensing optician in the state of licensure or registration for a period of at least five (5) years for licensure or three (3) years for registration immediately before his or her application for reciprocity to this state

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtaining a license or registration by fraud, misrepresentation, or concealment of material facts.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The applicant, licensee, or registrant obtaining a license or registration by means of fraud, misrepresentation, or concealment of material facts

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in bait-and-switch advertising, side-by-side operation adjacent to a prescriber, or capping and steering referral practices.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: engaging in the advertising practice commonly known as "bait and switch", or establishing an ophthalmic dispensing business immediately adjacent to the office of a licensed optometrist or physician skilled in diseases of the eye in what is commonly known as a "side-by-side" operation, or engaging in the referral procedure commonly known as "capping and steering"

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being convicted of a felony listed under § 17-3-102.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The applicant, licensee, or registrant being convicted of a felony listed under § 17-3-102

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating any prohibitive provision under this chapter.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The applicant, licensee, or registrant violating any prohibitive provision under this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in fraudulent, misleading, or deceptive advertising.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The applicant, licensee, or registrant engaging in any fraudulent, misleading, or deceptive advertising

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to qualify for the license or registration.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The applicant, licensee, or registrant failing to qualify for the license or registration

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating any other rule promulgated by the board.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The applicant, licensee, or registrant violating any other rule promulgated by the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Using narcotics or alcohol that impair the ability to perform the work of an ophthalmic dispenser.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The applicant, licensee, or registrant using any narcotic drug or alcohol which impairs his or her ability to perform the work of an ophthalmic dispenser.

establishment_regulation_required.quote: It shall be unlawful for any person or legal entity to conduct an office or place of business in this state where ophthalmic dispensing services are offered or performed unless that person or entity shall have first secured an office permit from the Arkansas Board of Dispensing Opticians pursuant to board rule for each such office or place of business.

definition_quote.value: "Ophthalmic dispensing" means the preparation of laboratory work orders, verification, and dispensing of spectacle lenses, spectacles, eyeglasses, or parts thereof to the intended wearer on a written prescription from a licensed physician skilled in disease of the eye or from a licensed optometrist.
definition_quote.quote: "Ophthalmic dispensing" means the preparation of laboratory work orders, verification, and dispensing of spectacle lenses, spectacles, eyeglasses, or parts thereof to the intended wearer on a written prescription from a licensed physician skilled in disease of the eye or from a licensed optometrist.

value: verification of finished spectacle lenses, spectacles, or eyeglasses
dispensing of spectacle lenses, spectacles, eyeglasses, or parts thereof
measuring, fitting, adapting, and adjusting spectacle lenses, spectacles, eyeglasses, or parts thereof to the human face
preparation and delivery of work orders to laboratory technicians
adjustment or repair of spectacle frames to the human face
methods_authorized.quote: "Opthalmic dispensing" shall include: (i) The measuring, fitting, adapting, and adjusting of spectacle lenses, spectacles, eyeglasses, or parts thereof to the human face; (ii) The preparation and delivery of work orders to laboratory technicians engaged in grinding lenses and fabrication of eyewear; (iii) The verification of the quality of finished spectacle lenses, spectacles, or eyeglasses; and (iv) The adjustment or repair of spectacle frames to the human face.

license_tier_structure.quote: "Licensed dispensing optician" means any person licensed by the board to engage in ophthalmic dispensing ... "Registered dispensing optician" means any person registered by the board to engage in ophthalmic dispensing ... "Apprentice dispensing optician" means an individual registered with the Arkansas Board of Dispensing Opticians to work under the supervision

contact_lens_scope_included.quote: The prescribing, adapting, fitting, duplicating, dispensing, modifying, selling, or supplying of contact lenses for or to the human eye is specifically excluded

duplicate_without_prescription_allowed.quote: It shall be unlawful for any dispensing optician or person engaged in the business of manufacturing, selling, or dispensing regular or safety ophthalmic materials to fill or duplicate an ophthalmic prescription without having a written prescription signed by the licensed optometrist or licensed physician skilled in disease of the eye who conducted the examination

written_prescription_required.quote: It shall be unlawful for any dispensing optician or person engaged in the business of manufacturing, selling, or dispensing regular or safety ophthalmic materials to fill or duplicate an ophthalmic prescription without having a written prescription signed by the licensed optometrist or licensed physician skilled in disease of the eye who conducted the examination from which the prescription was prepared.

ophthalmic_materials_quality_standard.quote: All ophthalmic materials, including eyeglasses, spectacles, lenses, or other optical devices or materials or parts thereof, sold in the State of Arkansas must conform to standards of quality as promulgated by the American National Standards Institute, commonly known as "Z-80.1 standards"

apprentice_to_supervisor_ratio_limit.quote: no licensed or registered dispensing optician shall supervise more than three (3) apprentices at a given time.

unlicensed_assistant_tasks_permitted.quote: Nothing in this chapter shall prohibit an employee of an Arkansas-licensed optometrist or an Arkansas-licensed physician skilled in disease of the eye from performing any of the acts described in § 17-89-102(4) when the acts are performed in the office of an Arkansas-licensed optometrist or an Arkansas-licensed physician skilled in disease of the eye. The employees are not required to be registered or licensed under the provisions of this chapter.

supervisor_physical_presence_required.quote: Licensed or registered opticians under this chapter may utilize apprentice dispensing opticians to engage in ophthalmic dispensing as defined in this chapter under their direct personal physical supervision and at the same location where the licensed or registered person dispenses.

licensed_optician_on_premises_required.quote: All businesses providing retail ophthalmic dispensing services, as defined in § 17-89-102(4), to the public must have physically present a licensed or registered dispensing optician within the place of business at the time the services are provided.

optical_establishment_permit_required.quote: It shall be unlawful for any person or legal entity to conduct an office or place of business in this state where ophthalmic dispensing services are offered or performed unless that person or entity shall have first secured an office permit from the Arkansas Board of Dispensing Opticians pursuant to board rule for each such office or place of business.

branch_office_limit_or_permit.quote: No licensed or registered dispensing optician or other person in this state shall establish more than two (2) ophthalmic dispensing branch offices in addition to his or her principal office unless he or she shall have first secured a branch office permit from the Arkansas Board of Dispensing Opticians.

colocation_with_prescriber_restrictions.quote: establishing an ophthalmic dispensing business immediately adjacent to the office of a licensed optometrist or physician skilled in diseases of the eye in what is commonly known as a "side-by-side" operation

advertising_disclaimer_required.quote: Any advertisement made by, for, or in behalf of any ophthalmic dispensing firm or any dispensing optician in this state ... shall cause to have printed thereon, or stated in oral advertisements, the following disclaimer: "This firm is not licensed to make eye examinations."

advertising_eye_exam_claim_prohibited.quote: The use in any advertisement ... of a picture, drawing, or other illustration or format which conveys the impression or belief that the ophthalmic dispenser or dispensing optician firm provides eye examinations or is qualified to give complete eye care service ... shall be deemed to be fraudulent, misleading, or deceptive advertising

approximate.matched_normalized: of a picture drawing or other illustration or format which conveys the impression or belief that the ophthalmic dispenser or dispensing optician firm provides eye examinations or is qualified to give complete eye care service

fee_splitting_with_prescriber_prohibited.quote: engaging in the referral procedure commonly known as "capping and steering"

value: Taking facial measurements for proper frame sizing
Fitting and adjusting glasses and frames to the face
apprenticeship_curriculum_subjects.quote: shown proficiency in those subjects and procedures designated by the board, including, but not limited to: (1) Mechanical optics; (2) Occupational vision requirements; (3) Taking facial measurements for proper frame sizing; (4) Ophthalmic lens types; and (5) Fitting and adjusting glasses and frames to the face.

school_program_substitution_for_apprenti.quote: Is a graduate of a school of opticianry whose curriculum consists of at least eighteen (18) months of didactic and practical instruction which is accredited by a national accreditation organization and approved by the board

apprentice_registration_required.quote: Apprentices may be employed upon submission of an application for registration as an apprentice dispensing optician to the Arkansas Board of Dispensing Opticians and approval by the board and payment of a fee to the board

scope_excludes_eye_examination_and_presc.quote: Nothing in this chapter shall be construed to authorize or permit any licensed or registered dispensing optician or any other person except a licensed optometrist or licensed physician skilled in disease of the eye to undertake or hold himself or herself out as being able: (1) To examine eyes by any objective or subjective method or exercise eyes; (2) To undertake by any method or means the measurement of the cornea of the human eye; or (3) To examine, prescribe, diagnose, treat, or correct for visual deficiency.

ready_made_nonprescription_eyewear_exemp.quote: nor shall it prohibit the sale of ready-made eyeglasses and spectacles when sold as merchandise at any established place of business where no attempt is made to practice optometry or opticianry.
